paragraphs.text: Dean Imbraham was a bird wizard and esteemed instructor at the Quandrix College within Strixhaven University on the plane of Arcavios .

Imbraham was a stern and perceptive owlin whose intellect was as sharp as the curve of his beak. He was famously known for his remarkable ability to rotate his head nearly 180 degrees, allowing him to address his students directly while simultaneously inscribing intricate mathematical formulas on the slateboard with impressive speed. His passion for numbers far exceeded his interest in socializing or spending time outdoors; some speculated that he had not been seen outside select areas of the Quandrix campus for many years.

Driven by an unrelenting desire to unravel the deepest mysteries of Arcavios , Imbraham dedicated himself to formulating complex theories that challenged even the most adept minds. To encourage his students' engagement with these difficult problems, he placed standing bounties on any of his unsolved equations—bounties which remained untouched until the arrival of Zimone Wola in his classes.
During the New Phyrexian Invasion , Imbraham, like many other Strixhaven teachers, was killed. His role as Dean of Theory of the Quandrix College was later taken over by Adrix .
